module: cross-call dispatcher (obs_prefetch_depth 1: prefetch of the next call's cut plus a slot-saturating dispatcher across call boundaries)
sign_convention: every delta is the cell minus the arm named in the pairing

identity_gate.basis: the sealed comparator's own committed score receipts and the null replicate's own committed verified score read, re-pooled from their 44 per-call rows; no arm is re-flown and no scorer is re-run

margins.caveat: A single replicate measures this null with 44 clusters and no more, AND it measures the noise of re-flying at depth 0, where a decode batch can only mix windows of one call. Section 4.1 of the preregistration says so in advance.

admission.rule: Section 4 of docs/readiness/2026-09-08-e21-dispatcher-admission-v1-preregistration.md, evaluated in order: HARMFUL if a gating metric's CI90 is disjoint from its null interval on the harmful side or its point delta exceeds the margin on that side; else ADMITTED if a gating metric's CI90 is disjoint from its null interval on the improving side; else NEUTRAL. The semantic high-impact rate is ADVISORY and never gating because its own same-request null excludes zero.

admission_against_null_replicate.rule: Section 4 of docs/readiness/2026-09-08-e21-dispatcher-admission-v1-preregistration.md, evaluated in order: HARMFUL if a gating metric's CI90 is disjoint from its null interval on the harmful side or its point delta exceeds the margin on that side; else ADMITTED if a gating metric's CI90 is disjoint from its null interval on the improving side; else NEUTRAL. The semantic high-impact rate is ADVISORY and never gating because its own same-request null excludes zero.

per_call_spread.note: the null replicate measured +/-1 point of per-call replicate noise on this carrier (its verdict section 5.1); no per-call reading here is admissible outside that band

depth0_null_replicate_this_session.label: SAEA-E21-FULL44-NULL-REPLICATE-V1 (depth 0, attached)
depth0_null_replicate_this_session.basis: obs_pipeline_dry_run.parse_stamp / _LAUNCH / _RELEASE / occupancy, applied to the resident session's own server.log over this attempt's contact window. Stamps are llama.cpp's own microsecond clock, converted to epoch through session.json started_at; a task counts for this attempt only if BOTH its launch and its release fall inside the window.

monitor_summary.parked_definition: every slot idle AND nvidia-smi utilization.gpu < 5%

throughput.claim: section 5 of the preregistration: windows per minute, mean slot utilisation and zero-slot share, measured by the same server-log replay on both arms of this session and quoted from the dry-run receipt for the comparator's own server
